testCountRationales.python-tests: Use the unittest discovery form from python-tests in .driver/gate-rules.json, narrowed to each changed test file; the host-observed Ran N total is the denominator.
testCountRationales.node-tests: Use Node's native --test runner on each changed file; the host-observed # tests total is the denominator.
testCountRationales.janus-tests: Reuse the janus-tests command in .driver/gate-rules.json; the Node test runner's # tests total is the host-observed denominator.
testCountRationales.weekly-recap-tests: Reuse weekly-recap-tests in .driver/gate-rules.json; unittest's host-observed Ran N total is the denominator.
testCountRationales.public-pr-wording-tests: Reuse public-pr-wording-tests in .driver/gate-rules.json; unittest's host-observed Ran N total is the denominator.
